scripts.dev: dotnet restore --no-cache --force-evaluate && dotnet watch run --project src/server --launch-profile https --no-restore --configuration Debug
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:server
scripts.test:server: dotnet build tests/server/Tracker.Tests/Tracker.Tests.csproj --configuration Release && dotnet exec tests/server/Tracker.Tests/bin/Release/net10.0-windows7.0/Tracker.Tests.dll --minimum-expected-tests 1 --output Detailed
scripts.test: pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:server
scripts.publish: pnpm run build:client && dotnet publish src/server --configuration Release -o ./publish
